resources.string: This computer talks to the television over ADB, on your local network. Nothing to install on the television.
Waiting for the television… If it asks to allow debugging from this computer, accept with the remote.
Connection refused: network debugging does not seem to be enabled on the television.
The television did not answer in time. If it shows an authorisation request, accept it with the remote, then try again.
The television closed the connection. Accept the debugging request with the remote, ticking “Always allow from this computer”.
Television unreachable: check that it is switched on and connected to the same network as this computer.
1. On the television, open Settings → About (sometimes under System or Device preferences), then press OK seven times on the build number. Developer options appear.
2. In Developer options, enable network debugging — depending on the television it is called “Network debugging”, “ADB debugging” or “USB debugging”.
3. Come back here: the television appears in the list above within a few seconds. Otherwise, type its IP address, shown in Settings → Network.
4. On the first connection, the television asks to allow debugging from this computer: accept with the remote, ticking “Always allow”. It will not ask again, even after a reboot.
Reachable over ADB. Click one to connect.
No television answers yet. Check that network debugging is enabled on it, or type its address below.
Wireless debugging only: enable network debugging on port 5555 instead.

Connect to a television to see its packages.

Preinstalled packages TV Slim does not describe yet, with their guessed origin. Shown for information only: nothing to disable from here. Export the list to help describe them: it adds what ADB tells about each one — location, system rights, sensitive declarations, icon, RAM and storage.

Only shell commands go through here: adb shell …, or the command alone. To install an APK, use the card above.

Reversible debloat for Android TV, over ADB from this computer. Nothing is uninstalled or installed on the television unless you ask for it — an APK you send, a command you type. Every change is recorded in the log, with the command that undoes it whenever there is one.
Open source: anyone can read the code, rebuild the application and check what it does.

Installing: TV Slim will restart on its own.
